name: Stamp Card
description: A stamp rally card: pressing an empty ring brings a seal down and leaves an inked impression.

props.name: slots
props.description: The rings, in order. Each slot's stamp shows its motif inside a double ring.

props.name: onStamp
props.description: Called when an empty ring is pressed. In controlled use, add the id to stamped.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading printed at the top of the card.

props.name: description
props.description: A short line under the heading.

props.name: ink
props.description: Colour of the ink, the rings and the counter. It is read in a light scope, since the card is paper in both themes.

props.name: children
props.description: Anything printed under the rings, such as terms or a prize line.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
